stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, China Saftower International Holding Group Limited is primarily engaged in the production and distribution of wires and cables. Its extensive product range includes copper and aluminum wires and cables tailored for electrical equipment, steel-reinforced aluminum bare cables, bare copper wires, and aluminum rods. In addition to manufacturing, the company trades aluminum products, such as strips and ingots, and provides various cable accessories. The firm caters to a broad customer base, including utility providers, industrial manufacturers, construction and renovation businesses, trading entities, and individual retail clients. Founded in 2004, China Saftower International Holding Group Limited maintains its corporate headquarters in Chengdu, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Red Fly Investments Limited.
